viral_opportunities.snippet: Author: @msuster | Text: It’s official. 18 months after the Pacific Palisades fires we have completed rebuilding our home from the ground up. I move in tonight. Much work ahead but I’m home & and a debt of gratitude to my wife for making this happen at record speed 😮‍💨 | URL: https://x.com/msuster/status/2080829156317970511 | Date: 2026-07-25 | Likes: 1274 | Retweets: 5 | Replies: 112 | Views: 73505 | Author followers: 0
viral_opportunities.author: @msuster
viral_opportunities.summary: High-profile VC (Mark Suster) shares completion of his Pacific Palisades home rebuild 18 months after the fires.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Palisades rebuild without design/insurance hook—capped per policy; monitor for any design details he might share next.

viral_reply.body: 18 months from ground-up to move-in night in the Palisades is remarkable. Congratulations to you both — that first night back home is a big one.

viral_opportunities.snippet:
Author: @shavnyuyngah | Text: When I say Kerala has some of the very best documented residential architecture right now, this is exactly what I mean. Don’t skip the comments, the best views of the home are there.

House of Corridors treats hallways as the actual point of the house, not the boring bit between rooms. Instead of enclosed rooms connected by circulation, the whole 3,900 sq ft home unfolds through corridors that widen into pauses, bend around courtyards, and spill into verandas and sh
viral_opportunities.author: @shavnyuyngah
viral_opportunities.summary: Viral thread praising Kerala's contemporary residential architecture as some of the best documented globally.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Engage as fellow design practitioners: compare Kerala's material/light strategies to Mediterranean villa typology and craft-forward concrete work.

viral_reply.body: Circulation as the actual room is hard to pull off — corridors widening into pauses around courtyards is the whole trick. Kerala's documentation culture deserves the attention.

viral_opportunities.snippet: Author: @dillonliam | Text: Rebuilding in Pacific Palisades and Altadena from the 2025 LA wildfires is close or at to some milestones, per @politico's tracker: * 148 completed homes * Almost half of the 9,900 properties with destroyed homes have filed permits to rebuild | URL: https://x.com/dillonliam/status/2079244608962539938 | Date: 2026-07-20 | Likes: 3 | Retweets: 2 | Replies: 2 | Views: 1288 | Author followers: 0
viral_opportunities.author: @dillonliam

viral_reply.body: Permits filed is the leading indicator here — completions lag well behind. Worth watching how many rebuilds go non-combustible; insurability is shaping plans as much as taste.
